verdict.rationale: Sentry documents SDKs for a broad range of platforms (Android, .NET, Elixir, Dart, JavaScript, etc.) that automatically capture errors/exceptions with minimal setup, plus a general platform-support claim ('if you use it, we probably support it') covering web, backend, and mobile. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of automatic uncaught-error capture across all listed SDKs (only first-party docs cited).
